[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
猫狗大战
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译
天地出版社｜TIANDI PRESS

[P2] 对农夫由美武术馆的学生来说，今天是一个特别的日子。
汪汪队、古威市长和她的咕咕鸡都来到了这里，一同见证功夫黄带段位的诞生。
“同学们，你们准备好了吗？”由美问道。狗狗们
已经迫不及待地想展示自己的本领了。

[P3] 狗狗们一个接一个地活动起来。灰灰舞长棍，毛毛打拳，天天踢飞腿，小砾做拉伸，路马也跃跃欲试。
阿奇宣布：“我将表演……阿、阿嚏！对不起，我对猫咪有点过敏！”
原来，云雾谷的柔道猫咪队也来农夫由美的武术馆了。

[P4] 哈丁格市长带领他的柔道猫咪队前来挑战，目的是证明他的猫咪比狗狗功夫更厉害。
“功夫狗狗训练有素！柔道猫咪多才多艺！但都比不上我的咕咕鸡！”古威市长说。
“咕咕咕！”咕咕鸡大叫着表示赞同，并立刻展示了一下自己的拳脚。
“我们不是来争谁更厉害的！”由美说，“我们的目的是让狗狗、猫咪、咕咕鸡和市长们展示自己最好的一面。”

[P5] 这时，哈丁格市长鼓掌示意猫咪开始表演。只见柔道猫咪们有的高高跃起、有的舞动拳脚、有的滚起球来，还有一只猫咪表演高空走绳呢。

“我来告诉你功夫狗大师是怎么运用绳索的！哟吼！”毛毛刚说完就抓住绳索一跃而起。

这时，一只调皮的猫咪从背包里弹出一支机器爪猛地钩住了绳索，使劲摇晃。

“砰！”毛毛一下子飞了出去。

[P6] 毛毛被重重地摔在了地上。
“你还好吗？”小砾关切地问。
“当然！一位功夫狗大师在摔倒时知道如何安全落地！”毛毛回答。
“下一项比试拳术格斗！”农夫由美说道。

[P7] 随后，狗狗们和猫咪们来到了格斗场地。毛毛和一只穿蓝色衣服的猫咪互相鞠躬致意后，挑战正式开始。只见毛毛高高跃起，而猫咪则从背包里掏出一团毛线向毛毛掷去。

“哎呀！”毛毛大叫一声，他又一次摔在了地上，四只脚被紧紧地缠住了。

“功夫狗？”哈丁格市长嘲笑道，“我看是摔跤狗吧，哈哈！”

[P8] 颁发段位的时间到了，由美给了每只狗狗一条金黄色的腰带，她为功夫狗狗们的付出而自豪，她说：“你们的刻苦训练和武术精神得到了大师们的肯定！”
而猫咪们则什么也没有得到。
“哈丁格市长，”由美说，“由于你的猫咪们还不懂得怎样控制自己和工具，所以我不能授予他们黄带了。”
“汪汪队万岁！”莱德和狗狗们欢呼道。

[P9] 小兔子,再见

这天,天气晴朗。波特先生来到由美的农场挑选胡萝卜。可是发生了一件怪事——地里的胡萝卜不见了!

“胡萝卜呢?”波特先生大叫道。

由美想:胡萝卜一定是被小兔子吃了。

看来,狗狗们又有工作要做啦!

[P10] 莱德让狗狗们迅速到塔台集合，并把小兔子惹麻烦的事告诉了大家。
“我们必须把小兔子转移到一个安全的地方，让它们不再偷吃由美的胡萝卜。小砾，我需要你用挖掘机帮我们找到兔子的地道！”
“出发啦！”小砾喊道。
“阿奇，你负责把兔子赶到一个地方。”莱德说道。
“阿奇收到！”警犬严肃地答道。

[P11] 莱德、小砾和阿奇迅速赶到由美的农场。
小砾立刻开始挖兔子的地道。“我发现了一个‘情况’！”不一会儿
他又喊道，“实际上，是两个‘情况’！”

[P12] 莱德打算把这两只兔子送离农场，于是他用平板电脑呼叫灰灰和天天：
“灰灰，你能找一些旧的狗笼，让天天把它们送过来吗？”
“旧物别丢掉，还有大用处！”灰灰答道。

“我会在小兔子尾巴摇晃两下的时间内赶到！”天天补充道。
天天带着狗笼来到了农场，阿奇开始把兔子赶进笼子里面。

[P13] 阿奇用扩音器喊道：“小家伙们！我们给你们准备了柔软舒适的窝，你们很快就到新家了。”
“每个笼子里面都有非常可口的点心哟！”天天说道。
小兔子们开心地跳进了笼子，天天驾驶着直升机把它们送到了一块新的田野上。
但是忙碌的一天并未到此结束！在波特先生搬运蔬菜回店里的路上，他在箱子里又发现了一些“毛茸茸的”“长着尾巴”的小家伙。
狗狗们又来新任务了。

[P14] 队员们迅速赶到波特先生的杂货店。
“能给我一些美味的胡萝卜蛋糕吗，波特先生？”莱德问道。他已经想好要怎样把小兔子给引出来了。
莱德把胡萝卜蛋糕放在地上，不一会儿，小兔子们蹦蹦跳跳地过来了。“现在，我们要用到你的网子，阿奇。”
阿奇用网迅速地把小兔子们罩住，莱德小心翼翼地把它们捧起来。

[P15] 天天再次把这些小兔子送到了它们的新家。莱德刚一打开笼子，小兔子们就开心地向草地冲去了，它们在花草丛里欢快地玩耍起来。
“小兔子，再见！”天天挥手道，“我会想念你们的！”

[P16] 当天天回到塔台时，她惊奇地发现有一只小兔子悄悄地跟着她回来了！
“我们能留下它吗？”天天问。
“当然啦！”莱德回答。
“太棒了！”天天欢呼着，其他狗狗也开心地欢迎着这个新成员。
full_text_en:
[P1] nickelodeon
PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Cat vs. Dog
By Nickelodeon Children's Channel
Translated by Anthony
Tiandi Press

[P2] For the students at Farmer Yu Mei's Martial Arts Academy, today is a special day.
The Paw Patrol, Mayor Goodway, and her chicken Gugu have all come here to witness the birth of the Kung Fu Yellow Belt rank.
"Class, are you all ready?" asked Yu Mei. The puppies
were already eager to show off their skills.

[P3] The puppies warmed up one by one. Rocky swung his long staff, Marshall punched, Skye kicked, Rubble stretched, and Chase was eager to go.
Chase announced, "I will perform... Ah-choo! Sorry, I'm a bit allergic to cats!"
It turned out that the柔道猫咪队 from Cloud Valley had also come to Farmer Yumi's martial arts hall.

[P4] Mayor Hadinger leads his Judo Cat Team in a challenge, aiming to prove that his cats are better at martial arts than the dogs.
"The Paw Patrol dogs are well-trained! The Judo cats are talented! But none can match my Gugu Chicken!" Mayor Goo says.
"Gugu-gu!" Gugu Chicken shouts in agreement and immediately shows off his own martial arts moves.
"We're not here to compete and see who's better!" Yu Mei says, "Our goal is to let dogs, cats, Gugu Chicken, and the mayors all show their best sides."

[P5] At this moment, Mayor Hardinger clapped his hands to signal the cats to begin their performance. The judo cats leaped high, some moved their fists and feet, some rolled balls, and one even performed high rope walking.

"I'll show you how the Kung Fu Dog Master uses the rope! Yo-ho!" Marshall said, then grabbed the rope and leaped up.

At that moment, a mischievous cat popped out a mechanical claw from its backpack, hooked it onto the rope, and shook it hard.

"Bang!" Marshall flew out immediately.

[P6] Mao Mao was重重地摔在了地上.
"Are you okay?" Zuma asked with concern.
"Of course! A kung fu dog master knows how to land safely when falling!" Mao Mao replied.
"Next up, hand-to-hand combat!" Farmer Yumi said.

[P7] Then, the puppies and kittens arrived at the fighting arena. After Rocky and a kitten in a blue outfit bowed to each other, the challenge officially began. Rocky jumped high into the air, while the kitten pulled out a ball of yarn from his backpack and threw it at Rocky.

"Oh no!" Rocky cried out, and he fell to the ground again, his four paws tightly tangled in the yarn.

"Kung Fu dog?" Mayor Humdinger laughed. "I'd say you're a wrestling dog, haha!"

[P8] It's time for the belt ceremony. Yumi gave each pup a golden yellow belt. Proud of the pups' hard work, she said, "Your dedication and martial spirit have earned the masters' approval!"
But the cats received nothing.
"Mayor Hattie," Yumi said, "your cats still don't know how to control themselves and their tools, so I cannot award them yellow belts."
"Paw Patrol forever!" Ryder and the pups cheered.

[P9] Goodbye, Little Rabbit

It was a sunny day. Mr. Porter came to Farmer Yumi's farm to pick carrots. But something strange happened—the carrots in the field were gone!

“Where are the carrots?” Mr. Porter shouted.

Yumi thought: The carrots must have been eaten by little rabbits.

Looks like the pups have another job to do!

[P10] Ryder gathered the pups at the command center and told them about the trouble the little rabbits had caused.
"We must move the little rabbits to a safe place so they won't steal Farmer Yumi's carrots anymore. Rubble, I need you to use the digger to help us find the rabbits' tunnel!"
"Let's go!" Rubble shouted.
"Chase, you're in charge of herding the rabbits to a specific location," Ryder said.
"Chase, copy that!" the police pup replied seriously.

[P11] Ryder, Rubble, and Chase quickly arrived at Yumi's farm.
Rubble immediately started digging the rabbits' tunnels. "I found a 'situation'!" In no time, he shouted again, "Actually, it's two 'situations'!"

[P12] Ryder planned to send these two rabbits away from the farm, so he used his tablet to call Rocky and Zuma:
"Rocky, can you find some old dog cages and have Zuma bring them over?"
"Don't throw away old things—they're still useful!" Rocky replied.

"I'll be there before the little rabbit wiggles its tail twice!" Zuma added.
Zuma arrived at the farm with the cages, and Chase began herding the rabbits into them.

[P13] Chase shouted through the megaphone: "Little ones! We've prepared soft and cozy homes for you. You'll be in your new home soon!"
"There's delicious treats in each cage!" Sky said.
The little bunnies happily jumped into the cages, and Sky flew the helicopter to take them to a new field.
But the busy day wasn't over yet! On Mr. Porter's way back to his store with vegetables, he found some more "fluffy" and "tail-waving" little creatures in the crates.
The pups had a new mission.

[P14] The team quickly arrived at Mr. Porter's grocery store.
"Can I have some delicious carrot cake, Mr. Porter?" Ryder asked. He had already figured out how to lure the little rabbits out.
Ryder placed the carrot cake on the ground. In no time, the little rabbits hopped over. "Now, we need to use your net, Chase."
Chase quickly covered the little rabbits with his net, and Ryder carefully picked them up.

[P15] Skye brought these little rabbits to their new home again. As Ryder opened the cage, the little rabbits happily rushed toward the grass, playing joyfully among the flowers.
"Bye-bye, little rabbits!" Skye waved, "I'll miss you all!"

[P16] When天天 returned to the tower, she was surprised to find a little rabbit secretly following her back!
"Can we keep it?"天天 asked.
"Of course!"莱德 replied.
"Great!"天天 cheered, and the other pups happily welcomed the new member.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《猫狗大战》的封面，展示了汪汪队中的狗狗角色与一只猫在木箱上对峙的场景，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P2] 本页描绘了农夫由美武术馆内，汪汪队、古威市长和咕咕鸡齐聚一堂，准备见证功夫黄带段位诞生的场景。由美询问学生们是否准备就绪，狗狗们兴奋地准备展示本领。
[P3] 狗狗们在武术馆内热身准备表演，阿奇因对猫过敏而打喷嚏，同时画面揭示云雾谷的柔道猫咪队也来到了武术馆。
[P4] 哈丁格市长带领柔道猫咪队前来挑战，声称猫咪功夫胜过狗狗，并夸赞自己的咕咕鸡。由美则强调活动目的并非争胜负，而是让大家展示最好的一面。
[P5] 哈丁格市长示意柔道猫咪队开始表演，猫咪们展示了各种功夫动作。毛毛准备用绳索展示技巧时，一只调皮的猫咪用机械爪钩住绳索并摇晃，导致毛毛被甩飞出去。
[P6] 毛毛在表演中被甩飞后重重摔在地上，小砾关心地询问他是否安好，毛毛自信地表示自己懂得安全落地，农夫由美随即宣布下一项比赛为拳术格斗。
[P7] 毛毛与一只蓝衣猫咪在格斗场对战，猫咪用毛线将毛毛缠住使其摔倒，哈丁格市长在一旁嘲笑毛毛是‘摔跤狗’。
[P8] 由美为汪汪队的狗狗们颁发了黄带，称赞他们的刻苦训练和武术精神，而哈丁格市长带领的猫咪们因未能控制好自己和工具而未获黄带，汪汪队为此欢呼庆祝。
[P9] 在晴朗的一天，波特先生来到由美的农场挑选胡萝卜，却发现胡萝卜不见了。由美认为是小兔子偷吃了，于是狗狗们又有了新的任务。
[P10] 莱德在指挥中心召集狗狗们，告知他们小兔子偷吃胡萝卜的麻烦，并分配任务：小砾用挖掘机寻找兔子地道，阿奇负责驱赶兔子。
[P11] 莱德、小砾和阿奇赶到由美的农场，小砾用挖掘机挖掘兔子地道，发现不止一只兔子在偷吃胡萝卜。
[P12] 莱德计划将偷吃胡萝卜的兔子送离农场，他通过平板电脑联系灰灰和天天，灰灰建议利用旧狗笼，天天承诺快速送达，随后天天带着狗笼抵达农场，阿奇开始将兔子赶进笼子。
[P13] 阿奇和天天将偷吃胡萝卜的兔子们用直升机送往新田野，但波特先生在运菜途中又发现新兔子，狗狗们因此接到新任务。
[P14] 莱德和狗狗们来到波特先生的杂货店，用胡萝卜蛋糕引诱偷吃胡萝卜的小兔子，并由阿奇用网罩住兔子，莱德小心地将它们捧起。
[P15] 天天将偷吃胡萝卜的小兔子们送到新家，莱德打开笼子后，兔子们开心地跑向草地玩耍，天天挥手告别并表示想念。
[P16] 天天带回了一只小兔子，莱德同意留下它，狗狗们开心地欢迎这个新成员。
